Join a lean-by-design, globally recognised B2B SaaS company as the German-speaking specialist for our DACH+ markets. No cold calling, no quotas — just meaningful conversations that help interested people discover how our software makes their work easier, then supporting them brilliantly once they're on board.

You won't be opening the market alone. Our marketing team already brings in German-speaking interest, and our experienced English-speaking sales colleagues handle these leads well. Your edge is simple and valuable: when a German-speaking prospect wants a demo auf Deutsch, or a new client wants onboarding and support in their own language, you're the person who makes that feel effortless — gründlich, verlässlich und auf den Punkt.

 

Join our Rebel Alliance

We're a diverse, remote crew that takes the work seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. You'll be a valued member of our global Client Success team, well supported with the tools, knowledge and people you need to do excellent work. In time you'll learn to work across teams and draw on our collective expertise — and you'll have real backing at every turn to grow into a confident product expert.

 

What you'll do

  • Run German-language demos for warm, interested leads — clearly and confidently

  • Become a product expert (with our support) and answer client and prospect questions accurately

  • Onboard and support clients in German and/or English, setting them up for success from day one

  • Provide responsive, thoughtful support in either German or English

  • Test scenarios carefully so your answers are technically correct, not guessed

  • Report recurring issues to help us improve the product

  • Build trust through honesty, empathy and reliability

 

What you bring (essentials)

  • Native-level German (C2) and strong business English

  • Minimum 3 years SaaS experience in support, onboarding, implementation or technical pre-sales

  • Real technical aptitude. Terms like HTML, CSS, JS, API, integrations, staging vs production, dev console and database queries are familiar — you needn't be a developer, but you should be genuinely comfortable around them and quick to learn the product's technical side

  • A confident communicator, written and spoken, who listens well

  • Comfortable discussing product value and guiding decisions — without the hard sell

  • Highly organised and process-driven; at home in a remote, tool-rich setup

  • Based in EMEA, ideally within DACH or close business-hours overlap (UTC+1/+2)

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with awards, grants, recognition or programme-management workflows

The short version

If you're technically sharp, genuinely enjoy helping people, and want to be the German-speaking specialist our DACH+ clients rely on, we'd love to hear from you. Komm an Bord!

Every search represents someone seeking reliable information. They depend on search results being accurate, trustworthy, and relevant to their local context. But search engines only learn to return trustworthy information if human evaluators with deep research expertise and cultural knowledge verify and correct them. Your linguistic precision, fact-checking rigor, and understanding of how your culture communicates and values information is irreplaceable in building search systems that people can actually trust.

 

In this role, you will evaluate search queries, results, and AI-generated content for factual accuracy, authority, relevance, and user intent alignment. Your judgment determines whether search systems return trustworthy, contextually appropriate information.

 

  • Analyze multi-turn search queries and web results for factual accuracy, source authority, and user intent alignment
  • Conduct cross-referencing and fact-checking using regional sources, specialized databases, academic resources, and web directories
  • Assess localized content relevancy across diverse domains—news, sports, local culture, technical queries considering regional context and cultural nuance
  • Evaluate AI-generated content for factual grounding, hallucination risk, and contextual appropriateness
  • Provide structured assessments that train search ranking and content relevance models

 

Qualifications to succeed in this project:

 

  • Professional fluency in English
  • Residency in the United States for the last 3 consecutive years  
  • Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content
  • Deep local cultural awareness and familiarity with regional news, current events, and contemporary culture
  • Strong fact-checking and critical thinking abilities
  • Access to a stable broadband internet, a reliable computer and a smartphone (Android 5.0, iOS 14 or higher)
  • Linguists, cross-cultural researchers, domain specialists, and detail-driven professionals with strong research methodology (preferred)

 

Why join the project:

 

  • Fully remote flexibility: Structure your contributions around research, consulting, teaching, or other professional commitments without rigid scheduling
  • Comprehensive research support: Access detailed evaluation guidelines, reference materials, databases, and resources for fact-checking across domains
  • Quality recognition: Performance assessments focused on consistency, fact-checking precision, and nuanced judgment
  • Intellectually demanding by design: If you are driven by fact-checking precision, source authority analysis, and the challenge of identifying what makes information truly trustworthy, this work is built for that mindset.
  • Responsive support: Direct access to evaluation support staff for clarification on ambiguous queries or technical guidance
  Qualification path

How to get started:

  • Complete your contributor profile and application
  • Take a qualification assessment at your own pace within the time given
  • Verify your identity through our secure identity verification process
  • Acceptance form & Rater Academy: Complete an acceptance form and approximately 2.5 hours of Rater Academy training
  • Receive your project assignment and access credentials

 

Service Rates 

The rate of pay is 0.2333 USD per task, with an estimated earning potential of 14 USD per hour.

Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines.

 

Independent Contractor Relationship

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

About Mitre Media

Mitre Media is redefining FinTech with AI-driven tools that empower millions of investors. Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time.

Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect!

About the Role

As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions.

You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes. As a technical leader, you'll have a seat at the table shaping system architecture, implementing core features all while embracing an entrepreneurial mindset and a “get things done” mentality.

Responsibilities

  • Integrate LLMs into our microservices architecture for state management and real-time user experiences.

  • Enhance front-end experiences with Hotwire, StimulusJS, or React, ensuring seamless AI-driven interactions.

  • Optimize LLM inference for low latency and cost, using caching and asynchronous processing.

Required Technical Skills

Back-End

  • Ruby on Rails (Rails 6-8 preferred)

  • PostgreSQL (or MySQL)

  • Elasticsearch

  • Redis

  • Docker

Front-End

  • HTML

AI Integration

  • Experience integrating AI/ML models (e.g., LLMs, NLP) with web applications

Nice-to-Have Technical Skills

  • Kubernetes for microservices orchestration

  • React for advanced front-end components

Required Soft Skills

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for AI and FinTech

  • Natural leader who mentors and inspires teammates

  • Problem-solver with a “get things done” mentality

  • Excellent communication, thriving in remote and cross-team collaboration

  • Attention to detail, ensuring clean, maintainable code

  • Team player comfortable as an individual contributor

Why Join Us?

  • Impactful Work: Build AI-powered tools that help millions of investors make informed decisions from data-driven insights.

  • Cutting-Edge Tech: Work with Rails 8, LLMs, and modern tools like Hotwire, Databricks, and xAI’s API in a microservices architecture.

  • Autonomy and Influence: Collaborate directly with our CEO and CTO to shape our AI-driven platform, with freedom to innovate.

  • Competitive Compensation: $160,000–$200,000 CAD/USD (based on experience) and benefits.

  • Remote Flexibility: Remote-first (±3 hours from ET) with hybrid in office collaboration in Toronto or NYC

  • Growth Opportunities: Budget for AI and Rails conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, RailsConf), plus access to cutting-edge AI tools for experimentation.

  • Dynamic Culture: Join a small, no-ego team passionate about trust, innovation, and making a difference in FinTech.

About Mitre Media’s AI-Driven Platform

Mitre Media powers premium financial brands like Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com with the Mitre Platform. This platform integrates traditional content management, financial data, first-party data, ad revenue, and subscription tools, all enhanced by LLMs for rich, user-focused experiences. Our data-derived insights delight users, while our advertising solutions deliver unmatched performance for partners like BlackRock and Vanguard, leveraging advanced targeting and first-party data.

Job Location: Remote


About Us: 

We are a dedicated team focused on improving access to affordable prescription medications for patients. By partnering with insurance companies, healthcare providers, and pharmacies, we work to reduce the financial burden of medications, ensuring that patients can access the treatments they need without excessive costs. 


Role Overview: 

As a key member of our team, you will help patients navigate our Prescription Payment Plan. This involves working closely with patients, insurance providers, healthcare professionals, and pharmacies to ensure seamless enrollment, eligibility verification, cost-sharing, and prescription fulfillment. 


What You’ll Do: 

  • Patient Enrollment & Eligibility: Assist patients with enrolling in the program, ensuring all necessary personal and insurance information is provided and verifying eligibility. 
  • Prescription Coverage: Help patients confirm that their prescribed medications are covered under the program, and manage the approval process for eligible medications. 
  • Cost-Sharing & Payment: Reduce patients' out-of-pocket costs by applying the program benefits. Manage copayments, coinsurance, and assist with additional copay assistance when applicable. 
  • Prescription Fulfillment: Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount. 
  • Refills & Continued Use: Support patients by ensuring they continue receiving medications at reduced costs, monitoring adherence to medication regimens, and ensuring continued eligibility. 
  • Program Renewal & Updates: Guide patients through annual renewals and inform them about any updates to the program or medication formulary. 


What We’re Looking For: 

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Experience in healthcare, insurance or customer service required (experience with prescription assistance programs is a plus)
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to navigate complex processes
  • Excellent communication skills for working with patients, healthcare providers, and pharmacies
  • A genuine passion for helping others and making a positive impact on their healthcare access
  • The ability to work efficiently and collaboratively within a team environment

  • Private Workspace: A dedicated, quiet workspace with a door that closes, free from ambient noise. 
  • Ergonomics: A comfortable desk and chair setup that allows for the proper installation of necessary equipment.

  • Quiet, Distraction-Free Workspace: A dedicated, quiet area where you can focus on delivering excellent customer service without interruptions. 
  • Tech-Savvy: Comfort with technology and ability to learn new systems quickly. 
  • Self-motivation & Independence: Ability to stay productive and manage your time effectively in a remote environment. 
  • Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills, especially in a virtual setting. 
  • Adaptability: Ability to adapt to changing technologies and procedures while working remotely. 


Compensation & Perks 

  • Hourly Pay: $16.50 per hour 
  • Company-Provided Equipment: All necessary equipment will be provided. 
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Full health insurance package including medical, dental, and vision coverage. 
  • Cell Phone Benefits: $25/month per line for unlimited phone, text, and data (restrictions may apply). 
  • Generous Referral Program: Earn $50 per paycheck for every person you refer—and your referral earns it too! No limits on payouts. 
  • Comprehensive Training: Paid training to ensure you are fully prepared for success. 
  • Career Growth: Opportunities for career advancement and professional development within a leading healthcare provider. 
  • Work-from-Home Convenience: Save time, and money, and reduce your environmental footprint. 
  • Inclusive Culture: We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including individuals with disabilities and veterans. 

What Success Looks Like: 

  • Reduced out-of-pocket costs for patients through effective cost-sharing and copay assistance 
  • Timely and accurate processing of prescription claims and approvals 
  • High patient satisfaction with the program’s support and streamlined experience 
  • Compliance with program requirements and monitoring of patient eligibility for ongoing assistance

  • Be part of a team that makes a real difference in patients' lives by reducing the cost of necessary medications 
  • Opportunity for professional growth in the healthcare and insurance sectors 
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package 
  • A collaborative, supportive, and innovative work culture

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

Wir verwandeln bedeutende Momente in wunderschöne Erinnerungen.

celebrate ist eine Markengruppe mit der Mission, in ganz Europa schöne Momente in bleibende Erinnerungen zu verwandeln: mit hochwertigen Papierwaren, Fotoprodukten und besonderen Geschenkartikeln.

Das jährliche Gehalt für diese Position liegt zwischen € 65.000 und € 85.000 (Senior).

  • Zuverlässigkeit unserer Shops durch SLOs, Incident-Leitung und Postmortems, deine Woche in der On-Call-Rotation und Peak-Vorbereitung mit Lasttests, Node-Sizing und Pre-Scaling

  • Weiterentwicklung unserer EKS-Plattform mit Karpenter, ArgoCD und Helm, inklusive Cluster-Upgrades, neuer AWS-Accounts und Infrastructure as Code mit Terraform und CDK

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Produktteams durch PR-Reviews, Deploy-Freigaben und Reliability-Fixes in ihrem Code, mit Raum für deine Weiterentwicklung in Security-Themen

Tech-Stack

  • AWS (EKS, VPC, WAF, RDS/Aurora, S3)

  • Kubernetes & Karpenter

  • ArgoCD & Helm

  • Kyverno

  • Terraform / AWS CDK

  • GitHub Actions & Renovate

  • Grafana Cloud & Grafana IRM

  • Alloy / OpenTelemetry

  • Prometheus

  • Wir sind ein Team: Office-Frühstück und Lunch, (freiwillige) Events, Remote Team-Building, Office Dogs, und exklusive Family & Friends-Rabatte


Dein Profil 

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in einer DevOps-, SRE- oder Plattform-Rolle mit Kubernetes im Produktivbetrieb, Helm und GitOps sowie fundierten AWS- und Terraform-Kenntnissen

  • Praxiserfahrung mit Metrics, Logs und Traces, Produktions-Incidents und SLOs sowie ein Software-Engineering-Hintergrund, z. B. mit Python, Go oder TypeScript

  • Gute Englischkenntnisse und klare schriftliche Kommunikation, Deutsch ist ein Plus

  • Strukturiert – Wenn nachts ein Alert anschlägt, behältst du den Überblick, leitest den Incident und sorgst dafür, dass aus dem Postmortem am nächsten Morgen ein besseres Runbook wird.

  • Pragmatisch – Du behebst lieber gemeinsam mit einem Produktteam einen Timeout oder ein Resource-Limit, als ein weiteres Tool einzuführen, und hast die Kosten immer im Blick.

  • Neugierig – Du schaust dir gern den Code unserer Engineers an, um ihre Probleme zu verstehen, und bist offen dafür, dich nebenbei in neue Bereiche wie Security einzuarbeiten.

celebrate company ist eine Gruppe aus sechs Marken: Atelier Rosemood, celebrate apps, celebrate digital printing, faireparterie, kartenmacherei und mintkind. jobs.description_html:
Bei Adlares machen wir Methanemissionen aus der Luft sichtbar – hochpräzise, zertifiziert und entscheidend für den Schutz kritischer Infrastruktur und den Klimaschutz. Mit unserem laserbasierten Messsystem CHARM® setzen wir den Industriestandard für die luftgestützte Gasfernüberwachung – und entwickeln aktuell die nächste, plattformunabhängige Systemgeneration (CHARM®3) sowie modernisierte Daten- und Auswerteprozesse im laufenden Betrieb.

Damit diese Neuentwicklung verlässlich gelingt, suchen wir eine Person mit hohen kommunikativen Fähigkeiten. Du stellst sicher, dass wir unsere Softwareentwicklung verbindlich planen und zum Ziel führen. Du definierst gemeinsam mit dem Produktmanagement die Ziele, übersetzt sie in einen realistischen Plan und trägst die Verantwortung für die Umsetzung. So bist du die zentrale Ansprechperson im Planungsprozess.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Ziele & Anforderungen: Gemeinsam mit dem Produktmanagement, dem Leiter IT und dem PO definierst du die Ziele der Softwareentwicklung. Du holst Anforderungen bei Operations, Laser- und Hardwareentwicklern und Nutzenden ein, erkennst Lücken und Widersprüche und übersetzt Deine Erkenntnisse in klare, umsetzbare Arbeitspakete für die Softwareentwicklung.

  • Planung & Kapazitäten: Du zerlegst Vorhaben in Epics und Tasks, planst Kapazitäten realistisch – inklusive Puffer für Betrieb und Tagesgeschäft – und machst Abhängigkeiten zu Hardware, Physik und Systemintegration frühzeitig sichtbar.

  • Umsetzungsverantwortung: Du sorgst dafür, dass Zusagen eingehalten werden: Du leitest das Daily, machst Fortschritt und Risiken transparent und steuerst nach, wenn etwas aus dem Plan läuft.

  • Entscheidungen herbeiführen: Offene Fragen bleiben bei dir nicht liegen. Du bereitest Entscheidungen vor, führst sie im Team oder mit dem Produktmanagement herbei, hältst sie fest und verfolgst ihre Umsetzung.

  • Architektur im Team: Architekturentscheidungen trifft das Team gemeinsam mit der IT-Leitung. Du moderierst diese Runden, bringst die Perspektive von Aufwand, Risiko und Planbarkeit ein und überführst die Ergebnisse in den Plan – auch bei der Frage, was wir am Bestand weiterführen und was wir schrittweise ablösen.

  • Mitentwickeln: Rund 20–30 % deiner Zeit arbeitest du selbst im Code, in Reviews oder an Prototypen. So kannst du Machbarkeit und Aufwand fundiert einschätzen.


  • Planungserfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Planung und Steuerung von Softwareentwicklung mit agilen und strukturierten Methoden – idealerweise in einem Umfeld, in dem Software, Hardware und Messtechnik zusammenkommen.

  • Verbindlichkeit: Du schaffst Klarheit und Verbindlichkeit.

  • Teamgeist: Unser multidisziplinäres Team aus Physikern, Software- und IT Entwicklern, Konstrukteuren und Datenanalysten bringt 25 Jahre Erfahrung in Entwicklung und Betrieb von LIDAR Systemen mit. Du bindest alle Stakeholder in den Zielfindungsprozess ein.

  • Analytisches Gespür: Du ziehst aus Gesprächen mit sehr unterschiedlichen Beteiligten das fachlich Relevante heraus und erkennst Lücken und Missverständnisse früh.

  • Entscheidungsstärke: Du führst Entscheidungen aktiv herbei, auch wenn noch nicht alle Informationen vorliegen, und hältst nach, dass sie umgesetzt werden.

  • Technisches Fundament: Fundierte Entwicklungspraxis mit Python, sicherer Umgang mit Prinzipien guter Softwareentwicklung und Verständnis für C++.

  • Wünschenswert: Erfahrung mit der Ablösung gewachsener Systeme (z. B. LabVIEW), mit Datenbanken, Messdaten und Signalverarbeitung sowie mit KI-gestützter Entwicklung. Dazu Neugier auf Spektroskopie, Laserphysik und Optik.

Was dich erwartet

  • Wirksamkeit: Eine Schlüsselrolle in einem zentralen Neuentwicklungsprojekt, in der du Planung, Arbeitsweise und Verlässlichkeit unserer Softwareentwicklung maßgeblich prägst.

  • Interdisziplinäres Team: Zusammenarbeit mit Fachleuten aus Physik, Ingenieurwesen und Softwareentwicklung – mit kurzen Wegen und offener Kommunikation.

  • Sinnstiftende Mission: Eine zertifizierte Technologie mit direktem Beitrag zu Anlagensicherheit und Klimaschutz.

  • Hybrides Arbeiten

jobs.description_html:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.  

We are looking for a highly structured, hands-on Senior People Operations Project & Process Manager (m/f/d) to join our European HR Operations team. This is a senior role for someone who takes on our tougher operational problems and drives them forward together with the teams involved. You will be a driving force behind scaling, harmonizing, and digitizing our People Operations processes. Your scope is Europe, with selected global projects and touchpoints on top.

At Flix, People Operations is a team with genuine ownership, business impact, and a seat at the table. As one of the senior drivers of our process landscape, you work alongside the wider team rather than alone, and you are a trusted senior voice on how our processes and projects fit together across markets. Your work directly shapes how HR operations functions at Flix, today in Europe and tomorrow on a global scale.

Our People Operations team is going through a significant digital transformation, with AI as a central part of how we are rethinking the way we work. Multiple projects are running in parallel across European and global scope, and this role contributes directly to that agenda. You do not need to arrive with deep AI expertise, but you need to be someone who is genuinely interested in exploring what AI-driven approaches can do for People Operations and who wants to grow with us in that direction. We have the people and the knowledge to develop these capabilities together.

This role is based in Berlin (hybrid model).

About the Role

  • Process Landscape Management & Optimization: Analyze, document, and continuously advance our People Operations process landscape across Europe. Map existing workflows, identify bottlenecks, and design lean, standardized, and scalable processes with global applicability in mind, keeping documentation and standards up to date as the organization evolves. Working with the Digital Transformation and Tech teams, you translate operational pain points into clear requirements, and drive automation where it creates real value on the ground
  • End-to-End Project Leadership & Change Management: Own complex, cross-functional HR initiatives end to end, including policy rollouts, compliance frameworks, operational restructuring, and transformation projects. You (co)-lead these independently from scoping through execution to handover, set the pace and the milestones, manage stakeholders and dependencies across markets, create operational playbooks, and ensure teams transition smoothly to new ways of working
  • Central Ops Counterpart: You are the central point of contact and the representative for People Operations in cross-functional projects, most importantly with our People Partners and the Digital Transformation team, and additionally with our Centers of Excellence and other stakeholders such as Finance. You make sure People Operations has a clear, informed voice in these initiatives across Europe and at global level, and you bring the operational perspective consistently into every cross-functional conversation
  • Day-to-Day Enablement: You actively support local European People Ops Managers by delivering tangible process improvements that make their daily work faster, safer, and easier

About You

  • Experience: 5+ years in HR Operations, HR Project Management, within a fast-paced, international organization or matrix environment
  • Process Expertise: Deep, hands-on track record of designing, mapping, and implementing complex HR processes, and of being the go-to person others rely on when a process spans multiple teams, departments, and markets
  • Project Management: You (co)-lead cross-functional projects end to end and independently, manage diverse stakeholders and dependencies, and keep scope, timelines, and budgets in check without close supervision
  • Tech-Savvy & AI Mindset: You have a solid understanding of modern HRIS and HR Service Delivery tools. You make decisions based on data and are genuinely curious about what AI and automation can do for People Operations. You do not need to be an expert today, but the interest and openness need to be there. We invest in building these capabilities together
  • Communicator: You can align different departments, push back constructively when needed, and simplify complex operational topics for any audience. Fluent in English; additional European languages, especially German, are a strong plus
  • Mindset: You push boundaries to challenge the status quo, and you build for generations by creating robust, audit-proof frameworks rather than quick fixes

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!  

What We Offer

  • Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

 

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Client Success Senior Manager to our Client Success team in Munich!

You'll manage a set of high-profile corporate accounts in Germany, ensuring that our clients remain focused on our mission of making wellbeing universal. You'll also drive the commercial agenda within your portfolio of clients, and collaborate with other teams to ensure that take-up of Wellhub is high within all of the accounts that you manage. This is a great opportunity to join a growing team and work with talented people and some of Germany's most innovative companies. We're looking for a superstar candidate who can help the team to achieve new levels of success.


YOUR IMPACT

  • Own client relationships for a portfolio of large corporate accounts throughout the entire post-sale client lifecycle in Germany, leading all in-person and virtual client communications and meetings.

Who We Are

AI is changing how software gets built. Code production is becoming a commodity. The focus is shifting from writing code to specifying, orchestrating, verifying, and governing change – and the toolchain is the new constraint.

We are at the center of this shift. We build Develocity, a toolchain observability and intelligence platform used by some of the world's leading software organizations – Netflix, Airbnb, Spotify, SAP, major global banks, and hundreds more. Develocity helps software teams achieve delivery excellence through deep observability, build and test acceleration, and AI-powered intelligence across the entire toolchain – with support for Gradle Build Tool, Apache Maven™, sbt, npm, Python, and Bazel.

We are an AI-native company. AI is not a feature we're bolting on – it's central to how we work, how we think about our product, and where we're heading. Develocity encodes a decade of build and test expertise into a context engineering layer: the ground truth AI agents need to change code safely, and the governance to attribute and gate that change at machine speed. Trust, evidence, and explainability are at the core of everything we build.

We have partnered with the Apache Software Foundation, the Commonhaus Foundation, the Micronaut Foundation, and other OSS projects such as Spring, Quarkus, Kotlin, JUnit, AndroidX, and many more to bring the values of Develocity also to the OSS Community.

Our Values

Seek to Understand: Everything starts with listening and understanding, and we strive to understand different viewpoints, problems, and motivations. Before we take action, we ensure we truly grasp the challenges, perspectives, and goals. 

Know the Why: We approach our work with a clear sense of purpose, ensuring every step is deliberate and focused. We take meaningful action with urgency, but never at the expense of thoughtful consideration. 

Innovate & Iterate: We embrace challenges and are not afraid to try new things, even if they might fail. With deep understanding and a clear purpose, we can develop creative and bold solutions to tackle challenges.

Own the Outcome: We are empowered to take initiative and we maintain transparency in our work and its outcomes. When we execute, we take responsibility for our decisions, measure the success of our innovations, and learn from the results.

Who You Are

We are looking for an experienced Senior Engineering Manager with a demonstrated ability to lead and grow distributed teams of strong engineers working remotely around the world. You enjoy the pace of a growing company, stay close to what your teams are building, and help the people around you take on more ownership.

Our ideal candidates are passionate about building products that help engineering teams ship better software, faster. They follow closely how AI is changing the way software gets built, and they want to help Develocity lead that change.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and empower several teams, working closely with their team leads, to deliver outcomes that matter to our users and the business, from long-term planning through to execution
  • Spot early risks to releases, team performance, or the business, and plan how to address them
  • Stay close to the technical work through design discussions, investigations, reviews, and guidance
  • Communicate clearly and early with other teams, departments, and stakeholders to meet release deadlines and business objectives
  • Cultivate a supportive team environment that encourages transparency and collaboration; support the personal and professional growth of everyone on your teams
  • Make the most of AI tools in your own work, and support your teams as they find new ways to build with AI

Minimum qualifications

  • 5+ years in a technical leadership role (3+ years in an Engineering Manager role)
  • Have managed more than one engineering team, working alongside team leads
  • The technical depth to serve as a partner to your engineers; you can challenge technical direction and identify risks early
  • Experience with a JVM-based product
  • Proven track record of leading complex initiatives that ship customer-facing products
  • Strong product and business mindset, coupled with a get-things-done attitude
  • Self-motivated and self-managing, with excellent organizational skills
  • Experience in leading and growing software teams and engineers
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills
  • A genuine interest in how AI is changing software development, and hands-on experience using AI tools in your own work

Preferred qualifications

  • Expertise in developer tooling, developer experience, or developer productivity
  • Experience managing remote, distributed teams
  • Experience in a high-growth startup or scale-up
  • Experience with AI-powered developer products, such as agents or MCP servers

What We Offer

  • Work on a widely used product with a clear vision for the future
  • Contribute to how software teams build and ship in the age of AI agents
  • Close interactions with customers from leading tech organizations
  • Close collaboration with experienced and dedicated peers and engineers
  • Room to grow your leadership scope
  • In-person meetings, such as our annual company offsite and team meetings
  • Work from home in a remote-first environment 
  • Competitive salaries and equity grants

Location

  • Remote, Europe-friendly timezone, with working conditions allowing seamless collaboration with your colleagues through email, chat, and video calls

🎤 Warum voize? Weil wir mehr als nur ein Job sind!

Bei voize glauben wir: Das Wertvollste, was wir Menschen in der Pflege geben können, ist Zeit. Zeit für Zuwendung, für Gespräche, fürs Dasein. Heute geht genau diese Zeit in Verwaltungsarbeit und komplexen Systemen verloren.

Unsere Vision ist es, das zu ändern: mit KI-Begleitern, die digitale Abläufe im Hintergrund übernehmen. Wir ersetzen keine Menschen durch Technik - wir verstärken ihre Wirkung.

Hinter unserer Mission steht eine Series-A-Finanzierung über 50 Mio. US-Dollar unter Führung von Balderton Capital, gemeinsam mit HV Capital, Y Combinator und weiteren führenden VCs. Über 2.000 Einrichtungen vertrauen heute auf voize, mehr als 200.000 Nutzer:innen entlastet unser KI-Begleiter im Alltag.

Und jetzt suchen wir dich, damit du mit uns auf diese Mission gehst!

💡 Deine Mission - Pflegekräfte begeistern und Digitalisierung im Pflegealltag gestalten

Als Onboarding Manager:in - Trainer:in für digitale Pflegedokumentation sorgst du dafür, dass Pflegekräfte unseren KI-Begleiter sicher im Alltag nutzen. Du schulst Gruppen von 10 bis 15 Pflegekräften direkt bei unseren Kund:innen nach der Teach-Try-Apply-Methode und bringst deine Pflegeerfahrung ein, damit aus Dokumentationszeit wieder Zeit für Zuwendung wird.

🚀 Dein Arbeitsalltag - Keine zwei Tage sind gleich

  • Schulungen vor Ort leiten: Du gestaltest und führst eigenverantwortlich Schulungen nach der Teach-Try-Apply-Methode (TTA: Erklären, Ausprobieren, Anwenden) durch und begleitest Pflegekräfte dabei, voize direkt in ihrem Arbeitsalltag anzuwenden.

  • Online schulen: Je nach Bedarf schulst du per Videocall in einem eigenen Format, das nicht dem TTA-Ablauf folgt.

  • Digitalisierung begleiten: Du unterstützt Pflegekräfte bei neuen digitalen Arbeitsweisen und begleitest sie durch Veränderungen, damit der KI-Begleiter im Alltag wirklich ankommt.

  • Pflegeexpertise einbringen: Du erkennst Herausforderungen und Bedürfnisse in unterschiedlichen Einrichtungen und gibst sie gemeinsam mit Support und Customer Success direkt an unsere Produktteams weiter.

  • Schulungen weiterentwickeln: Du verbesserst Materialien und Abläufe laufend anhand von Feedback und Stolpersteinen im Onboarding.

🤝 Dein Profil - Das bringst du mit

  • Pflegeausbildung oder praktische Erfahrung in der Pflege (stationäre Langzeitpflege, Krankenhaus oder ambulant) - du kennst Pflegedokumentation und Alltagsroutinen aus eigener Erfahrung.

  • Erfahrung darin, Kolleg:innen anzuleiten, z. B. als Praxisanleiter:in, Mentor:in oder Digital Champion. Praxisnahe Schulungsformate, in denen Teilnehmende selbst üben, sind ein Plus.

  • Glaubwürdigkeit und Kommunikationsstärke, um Gruppen von 10 bis 15 Pflegekräften auch unter Zeitdruck zu begeistern und zu motivieren.

  • Begeisterung für Technologie, die die Pflege leichter macht, und Geduld, Kolleg:innen durch Veränderungen zu begleiten.

  • Fließend Deutsch (C2) und die Bereitschaft, 2 bis 3 Mal pro Woche für TTA-Schulungen vor Ort zu reisen.

🌱 Gemeinsam wachsen – Das erwartet dich bei voize

  • Eine neue berufliche Perspektive: Entwickle dich außerhalb der klassischen Pflegelaufbahn weiter, ohne der Pflege den Rücken zu kehren.

  • Keine Schicht-, Nacht- oder Wochenenddienste: Gestalte deinen Alltag außerhalb des klassischen Schichtsystems.

  • Strukturierte Einarbeitung: Erfahrene Trainer:innen begleiten dich bei deinem Einstieg.

  • Eigenverantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum: Du bringst eigene Ideen ein und gestaltest Schulungen und Prozesse aktiv mit.

  • Offene Unternehmenskultur: Regelmäßige Team-Events, ob du aus unserem Berliner Office oder remote aus Deutschland arbeitest.

  • Moderne Arbeitsausstattung für dein mobiles Arbeiten.

  • Beteiligung am Unternehmenserfolg: Mit Stock Options wirst du Teil unseres Erfolgs.

  • Attraktive Benefits: 30 Urlaubstage plus dein Geburtstag frei, Deutschlandticket, Urban Sports Club, regelmäßige Company-Offsites sowie Zugang zu Blinkist und Audible.

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Flexible Arbeitszeiten im Rahmen deiner Kundentermine und ein gutes Hybrid-Setup.

✨ Bereit für ein Gespräch? Jetzt bewerben!

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung und darauf, dich kennenzulernen, ganz gleich, wer du bist und welchen Hintergrund du mitbringst.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

The role

🎯 Your main goal will be to build and own n8n's reseller channel across the Middle East, Africa and APAC, turning the product-led adoption we already see in these markets into a repeatable revenue engine.

As the first person dedicated to our resale motion in MEA & APAC, here is what you'll own:

🧭 Design the MEA & APAC channel strategy

  • Define the go-to-market and travel plan for the region and select the 10 to 15 reseller partners to start with.

  • Recruit and onboard new resellers while growing relationships with existing partners.

  • Build a first pipeline with your partners within your first three months.

📈 Own the channel number

  • Carry the ARR target for the MEA & APAC channel and run the full sales cycle with and through partners.

  • Qualify, forecast and close deals alongside your resellers, joining customer calls when it helps.

  • Grow closed ARR above the region's previous run rate within your first six months.

🤝 Enable partners and represent n8n

  • Help resellers build a repeatable, profitable business around n8n.

  • Coordinate with partner solutions engineering, the agency program, partner marketing, partner enablement and sales.

  • Represent n8n internally and externally across MEA & APAC.

Must-haves

  • 💰 Quota-carrying experience: You're comfortable carrying a direct sales quota and running full sales cycles.

  • 🤝 Channel experience: You have 5+ years in a partner, channel or sales role at a tech company.

  • 🔁 Resale motion: You have built a resale motion with both new and existing partners.

  • 🧠 Technical acumen: You understand technical products well enough to position and discuss n8n with confidence.

  • 🚀 Builder mindset: You thrive in a dynamic scale-up, work self-sufficiently and don't need established processes to deliver.

  • 🗣️ English: You're fluent in English, at full professional level.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🌐 Regional network: You have a strong network among reseller and solution partners in MEA & APAC.

  • 🗺️ Regional languages: You speak Korean, Japanese or Arabic.

Location

Remote, based in Europe. You need an existing right to work in your country of residence (we can sponsor visas for Germany only).

Why join us?

Enterprise customers across MEA & APAC already use n8n through our product-led motion. Your job will be to turn that momentum into sales growth, as the owner of the entire channel across the territory. You'll shape our go-to-market in these markets from day one, with real autonomy and visibility, and join a fast-growing, remote-first team that values speed and builders who own their results.

Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

Apply now and help us build the future of automation.

Headquarters: Remote US

Head of Content

Outmarket AI · Remote (US) · Full-time · Reports to the SVP of Marketing

About Outmarket

Insurance still runs on manual work. Most policies are sold through agents and brokers, and the people who know the work best are buried in the documents: checking policies line by line, comparing quotes, building proposals, on nights and weekends. We think that's backwards. The best people in insurance should spend their time advising clients.

Outmarket, the AI platform built for insurance, makes that possible. Account teams drop in their documents and get back finished work to review, with every finding linked to the page it came from. Outmarket connects to the systems they already use. The judgment stays with the person; the groundwork doesn't.

It's working. More than 10,000 people at over 300 agencies use Outmarket, including 30 of the top 100 U.S. insurance brokers. Most of those agencies found us through other customers. We raised a $34.5M Series B led by SignalFire four months after announcing our Series A because customers were pulling us forward faster than we planned.

Why this role

  • Customers who want to talk. About 300 agencies use Outmarket, and most will go on record about it. Few content leaders start with that many stories ready to tell.

  • First in the seat. You'll be our first content hire, joining alongside a new Head of Product Marketing and Head of Growth. You'll decide what Outmarket sounds and looks like.

  • Real creative room, and a budget to use it. There's budget for specialist contractors such as editors, shooters and designers, and you'll have room to make work that doesn't look like typical B2B content.

  • A direct line. You'll work with the SVP of Marketing, the founders and customers, and you'll see what your work does for pipeline within weeks.

The role

You own video, social, customer stories and written content. You'll build the function hands-on: you script, interview, direct and write yourself, and you work with a small group of specialist contractors instead of an in-house crew. Pipeline is the team's main number, so success means content that brings brokers into sales conversations, not just views.

Our buyers are owners, producers and operations leaders at commercial insurance agencies. It's a relationship-driven industry, and we're still learning where these buyers spend their attention online. Part of your job is finding out, then making the content that reaches them there.

What you'll do

  • Run the customer story program. Choose which customers to feature with our client services team, plan each story before the shoot, run the interview, and cut one day of filming into pieces for the website, ads, sales and events. Make it easy for busy customers to say yes, and never over-ask the same ones.

  • Ship every week. Build a steady publishing rhythm with a bench of specialist contractors. Find them, brief them clearly, know what things should cost, and review closely so quality holds as volume grows.

  • Turn our events into content. Work with our Director of Industry Events & Programs to plan what to capture at the conferences and customer dinners we already run, and publish soon after.

  • Find where brokers pay attention, whether that's LinkedIn, YouTube, industry media or events. Put our effort where the audience is, not where content teams usually start.

  • Build leaders' voices. Help our founders and other leaders post every week, each in their own voice.

  • Own written content, including the site, social and long-form pieces, and keep everything we publish clear and sharp.

  • Measure what your content does for pipeline and use that to decide what to make next.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years in B2B content, brand or creative, including time owning a content program end to end.

  • You've personally made content that grew an audience or produced demos and pipeline, and you can explain the numbers and your part in them.

  • You're a hands-on maker. You've scripted, directed, interviewed and edited video and social content yourself, not only managed an agency or writers.

  • You've produced customer stories people actually watch, and you know how to run a great interview.

  • You've shipped on a small budget with contractors and can say what each piece cost.

  • You've built content at an early-stage company, ideally Series A to C, and want to build from scratch again.

  • You're an excellent writer.

How we work

  • High agency: you find the work instead of waiting for it.
